name: What is private listing access in real estate?

mainEntity.name: What is private listing access in real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Private listing access refers to the ability to view properties that are not yet publicly advertised on the Multiple Listing Service (MLS) or other widely accessible platforms. These listings, often called 'pocket listings' or 'off-market homes,' are shared directly by agents within their networks before general market release. Gaining this access can provide a competitive edge in fast-moving markets like Miami-Dade or Broward County by allowing buyers to see properties before they are widely known.
acceptedAnswer.description: Private listing access allows buyers to view properties not yet publicly advertised, often shared directly by agents within their networks.
